function.name: clawcommit_commit
function.description: Commit an AI decision hash to BNB Chain. Hash is computed from prompt, output, modelVersion, and nonce; only the hash is stored at commit time.

prompt.description: Prompt/context used by the AI model.

model_version.description: Model version string used to generate the output.

nonce.description: Optional cryptographic nonce. If omitted, generate a secure nonce and return it.

contract_address.description: Deployed ClawCommit contract address on BSC.

private_key.description: Wallet private key for signing commit transaction.

allow_mainnet_writes.description: Set true to allow state-changing operations on BSC mainnet.

log_sensitive.description: Set true to include prompt/output/nonce in logs and responses.

function.name: clawcommit_reveal
function.description: Reveal a previously committed decision payload. Only original committer can reveal.

prompt.description: Original prompt used during commit hash computation.

output.description: Original output used during commit hash computation.

model_version.description: Original model version used during commit hash computation.

nonce.description: Original nonce used during commit hash computation.

private_key.description: Private key of wallet that created the commitment.

allow_mainnet_writes.description: Set true to allow state-changing operations on BSC mainnet.

log_sensitive.description: Set true to include prompt/output/nonce in logs and responses.

function.name: clawcommit_verify
function.description: Verify a revealed commitment by replaying hash computation over prompt/output/modelVersion/nonce.

log_sensitive.description: Set true to include prompt/output/nonce in responses.

function.name: clawcommit_compute_hash
function.description: Compute deterministic keccak256 hash from prompt, output, modelVersion, nonce without blockchain writes.

contract_address.description: Optional contract address if using on-chain pure call instead of local hashing.

log_sensitive.description: Set true to include prompt/output/nonce in responses.

function.name: clawcommit_get_commitment
function.description: Retrieve commitment data including prompt/output/modelVersion/nonce (if revealed).
